profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Knight Swift Transportation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for development of the business intelligence software named ‘Universal Floor Optimizer (UFO)’ for Casino Industry. The application is used by casino to optimize and analyze their floor. UFO will help Casino to predict and improve the performance of the games on their floor.
•	Design and develop a Silverlight based secured web application using C# by using object oriented programming methodologies
•	Using third party controls like Infragistics and Telerik
•	Using Linq to SQL to select, update and insert data into database
•	Create and maintain secured WCF services for application use only
•	Create WinForm utility to encrypt and decrypt data strings as needed for application
•	Wrote store procedures and queries in SQL Server
•	Performing unit testing on the application
•	Interact with Business analysts to answer the application specific questions for client training; requirement gathering
•	Prepare technical documentation for different project modules
•	Deploy application package on client server
•	Using TFS for version control of an application

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in a team to develop and maintain patient management software. The application allows users to keep track of patient’s medical records, prescriptions and compliance data.
